customer_support.problem_1_text: Customers re-explain issues agents already have in the thread, wasting time on both sides.
customer_support.problem_2_text: Move from chat to email to phone and everything the customer already said disappears.
customer_support.problem_3_text: Recurring bugs and repeat escalations go unnoticed when nothing connects across sessions.
customer_support.feature_1_text: Agents remember past conversations, problems, and resolutions without digging through tickets.
customer_support.feature_2_text: Spots recurring issues across users so teams can act before things escalate.
customer_support.feature_3_text: Carries memory across chat, email, and phone interactions with preserved context.
customer_support.feature_4_text: Replies reflect tone, urgency, and past behavior to feel more human.
customer_support.benefit_1_text: Run smarter agents without stuffing every ticket into the prompt. Retrieve only what matters, in under 10ms.
customer_support.benefit_1_item_1: Memory lives outside the context window
customer_support.benefit_1_item_2: Up to 90% less redundant context per reply
customer_support.benefit_1_item_3: Handles long threads without losing the plot
customer_support.benefit_2_text: Drop Actx0 into your existing helpdesk, chatbot, or agent stack. No pipeline rewrite required.
customer_support.why_1_text: Past issues, tone, and resolutions, surfaced instantly, not dug up manually.
customer_support.why_2_text: Chat, email, and voice share the same memory. No more starting over.
customer_support.why_3_text: Hand off between chatbot and live agent without losing a single detail.
customer_support.why_4_text: Detect repeat complaints across customers before they become outages.
customer_support.why_5_text: Remember what matters. Forget what shouldn't stick around.
customer_support.why_6_text: Add memory with a few API calls. No support flow rebuild.
